title: The kb-observer agent file lists every command kb_backlog serves
goal: the kb-observer agent file's read-only commands step lists held, referrers, find, similar, tree, config, landings, runs, procs, check, report and usage beside the commands it already lists as served by kb_backlog

run:
import sys
t = open(".claude/agents/kb-observer.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
i = t.find("Read-only commands you may run")
seg = t[i:i + 900] if i >= 0 else ""
names = ["held", "referrers", "find", "similar", "tree", "config", "landings", "runs", "procs", "check", "report", "usage"]
miss = [n for n in names if "`" + n + "`" not in seg]
print("missing:", miss)
sys.exit(1 if miss or not seg else 0)
